title: Emails > Email Forwarders > How to Create and Manage Email Forwarders

sections.heading: Creating Email Forwarders
sections.content: Email forwarders allow you to automatically forward incoming emails sent to an address on your domain (e.g. info@yourdirectory.com) to an external personal or team inbox (e.g. yourname@gmail.com) without requiring a separate paid mailbox.

sections.heading: Setup Instructions
sections.content:
1. Go to Emails > Email Forwarders in the Admin Dashboard.
2. Click 'Add New Forwarder'.
3. Enter the source alias and destination email address.
4. Click Save.
